assumptions: UNVERIFIED-ASSUMPTION: every OpenEMS component id, channel id, channel unit and sign meaning declared in this profile was written from the OpenEMS documentation shape recorded in RESEARCH.md section 1 and the report section 27 OpenEMS references — the OpenEMS REST API was NEVER executed when this profile was written. Every entry must be diffed against a real lab EdgeConfig during the P6.11 lab run before this profile is trusted for any non-lab use.

UNVERIFIED-ASSUMPTION: OpenEMS SymmetricEss ActivePower sign meaning is declared here as export-positive (positive = export at the point of connection, already canonical). If the lab Edge shows the opposite sign (charge-positive/discharge-negative is common for ESS inverter channels), the correction is a PROFILE EDIT (native_sign: import-positive), never a code change.

UNVERIFIED-ASSUMPTION: OpenEMS ReactivePower sign meaning is declared here as injection-positive (Q > 0 = injection into the grid). The convention travels on every reactive record (P0.07 section 3); a lab finding of consumption-positive is a PROFILE EDIT.

UNVERIFIED-ASSUMPTION: the grid meter (meter0) native sign is declared import-positive (positive = consumption from the grid, the common meter convention). The adapter negates explicitly under the FlexCore canonical rule P > 0 = export. A lab finding of export-positive is a PROFILE EDIT.

UNVERIFIED-ASSUMPTION: OpenEMS REST channel values carry no quality code. Each mapping entry declares the quality code the adapter attaches to a FRESH reading of that channel (declared_good below). This is an explicit, versioned, reviewed declaration — not an implicit default; the adapter refuses (no quality) any channel entry that omits it, and flags genuinely degraded feeds through the freshness limit (STALE).

The Getting Started defaults (admin/admin, Metadata.Dummy, ws://) documented in RESEARCH.md section 1 are NEVER acceptable here: this profile carries no credentials and the adapter authenticates by nothing but what the deployment composes (P6.06 identity; lab transport composition).

declared_unmapped.reason: OpenEMS metadata component state (run-level status of the Edge itself) — infrastructure diagnostics, not DER telemetry; no FlexCore canonical quantity applies.

An ESS LIMIT channel (the charge power the inverter currently allows) — a control-side constraint input, not a measured telemetry point; FlexCore reads it only when a capability/envelope wave maps it to a declared canonical quantity. v1 declares no such quantity.
